newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India tenders to buy 30,000/T May 15-19 fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to buy 30,000/T May 15-19 fuel oil.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy 30,000 tonnes of 3.5-percent sulphur, 180-centistoke fuel oil for May 15-19 delivery, cost-and-freight (c-and-f) Bombay, traders said on Monday.
The tender closes on May 1 and will be valid for one day.
India has another tender to buy 30,000 tonnes of fuel oil, which closes on April 24, for May 6-10 delivery, c-and-f Bombay on the Indian west coast.
IOC cancelled an earlier tender to buy 14,000 barrels of fuel oil for May 5-8 delivery, which was due to close on April 23.
